question: Should the Android upgrade intentionally disable every pre-disclosure Installed Apps opt-in until the user accepts the version-1 disclosure?
rationale: Treating the old boolean as current consent would undermine the policy fix, while clearing it is a deliberate user-visible compatibility change that the assigned maintainer must own before release.

options.title: Require fresh consent
options.body: Accept the patch's privacy-protective reset so no existing device.apps opt-in remains active without the current disclosure.

options.title: Redesign the transition
options.body: Pause landing only if maintainers can define another policy-compliant upgrade transition that does not treat the old toggle as consent to unseen disclosure text.

recommendation.title: Require fresh consent
recommendation.body: Accept the patch's privacy-protective reset so no existing device.apps opt-in remains active without the current disclosure.

likelyOwner.reason: The assigned owner authored and force-pushed the exact current head and is best positioned to accept the Android upgrade behavior.
